scope: France, Spain and Swiss family camps: published 2026/27 facts, not a complete European ranking
findings: NLD: three Spanish cities, 8–15, whole programme explicitly English, EUR 960 / 1850 / 2680 for 1 / 2 / 3 weeks. One dossier, three separate city windows; exact short arrivals and campus addresses unknown.
NLD: robotics in illustrative general camp schedule; NLD League Houses is an internal house game, not a world robotics league. No invented kit, teaching hours or world ranking.
NLD: EUR 300 European management charge already in price; deposit amount assigned per programme; balance 45 days before start. Cancellation boundary at 60 days overlaps; no application submitted.
IH: 2026/27 standard and premium PDF confirm 5–30 July 2027, Paris / Nice / Biarritz. Twelve summer week variants added; exact addresses checked visually in PDF page 5.
IH: standard 340 Paris / Nice, 360 Biarritz; premium 430 / 450. Registration fee waived; premium increment 90, meals and possible activity transport excluded.

IH: fifteen future non-conflicting cohorts have five timed weekdays each. Three 12–16 July windows retain uncertain 14 July attendance due general holiday exclusion. Do not prorate weekly fee or promise five teaching days.
Wander: fresh HTML replaces autumn card with Christmas MiniCamp 21–23 December 2026. Both children fit 3–12; no published three-day fee. Spring still says 2017 and is not promoted to 2027.

Wander: seven future variants yield 38 actual timed day entries; weekly discount applies to multiple weeks per child, not two siblings sharing one week. Terms page is a Wix drafting template, not an operational refund contract.

La Garenne: 2027 PDF confirms existing fees. Three two-week day sessions have 11 days including first Saturday, 08:50–18:00. Four-week day attendance kept as windows because intermediate Saturdays unspecified. Nearby parent stay requires day format.
TASIS / Camp Suisse: reviewed current price pages agree with existing 2027 tariff facts; no duplicate dossiers or claim that all prior dossier fields were freshly reverified.

Ermitage: current autumn 2026 body tariff does not establish 2027 fee. TECS: yearless session dates and general 2027 navigation do not prove a dated 2027 session. Sotogrande / King’s returned access wrappers; no source-refresh claim.
